name: kettlebell snatch
description: Swinging a kettlebell from between your legs to overhead in one motion. It builds power through the whole body.
instructions: Stand over the kettlebell and hinge to grip it with one hand.
Swing it back between your legs.
Drive your hips forward and pull the bell up close to your body.
Punch your hand through to catch it overhead with a straight arm.
Lower it back under control and repeat, then switch arms.
